Found by adversarial review of the CI-failure-reduction items (WS2 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md is delegated to dev-loop-step-6-queue-decision-gate). The gate's DESIGN content (Path A native merge queue vs Path B steward, trust-lane anti-patterns, queue-tier CI policy) is sound and must be preserved - only its mechanics need re-homing.

Since the tracker has no update command, the refresh means: drop the stale item with a reason pointing here, and recreate it carrying over its design content with (a) scope/verifications re-homed to the hosted tracker (_project/decisions/dev-loop-queue-path-*.md stays; selected-path TODO becomes a `todo create`, verified via `todo show`), (b) its step-5 blocked_reason re-evaluated, and (c) the WS9 baseline 2-week review added as an explicit input to the w1 BUILD/DO-NOT-BUILD decision.
